list.name: bucket
list.label: Node
list.definition: buckets() |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /^telegraf-/) |> keep(columns: ["name"]) |> rename(columns: {name: "_value"}) |> sort()
list.query: buckets() |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /^telegraf-/) |> keep(columns: ["name"]) |> rename(columns: {name: "_value"}) |> sort()

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.definition: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status") |> keep(columns: ["container_name"]) |> group() |> distinct(column: "container_name") |> rename(columns: {container_name: "_value"}) |> sort()
list.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status") |> keep(columns: ["container_name"]) |> group() |> distinct(column: "container_name") |> rename(columns: {container_name: "_value"}) |> sort()

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "uptime")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r._field == "usage_idle")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - r._value }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "swap" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r.path == "/" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "load1")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_user" or r._field == "usage_system" or r._field == "usage_iowait" or r._field == "usage_softirq" or r._field == "usage_irq" or r._field == "usage_nice" or r._field == "usage_steal" or r._field == "usage_guest")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "load1" or r._field == "load5" or r._field == "load15" or r._field == "n_cpus")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "used" or r._field == "cached" or r._field == "buffered" or r._field == "free" or r._field == "available")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "net" and (r._field == "bytes_recv" or r._field == "bytes_sent"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.interface != "lo")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._field == "bytes_sent" then -1.0 * r._value else r._value }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "interface", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["path", "_value"])
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "diskio" and (r._field == "read_bytes" or r._field == "write_bytes"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._field == "write_bytes" then -1.0 * r._value else r._value }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "name", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker" and r._field == "n_containers_running")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker" and r._field == "n_containers_stopped")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_images" and r._field == "total")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_images" and r._field == "dangling")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_images" and r._field == "reclaimable_bytes")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_health" and r._field == "failing_streak")
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status" and r._field == "uptime_ns" and r.container_status == "running")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "container_image", "container_status", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Uptime"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["container_name"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r._field == "usage_percent")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "CPU %"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_mem" and r._field == "usage_percent")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Mem %"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_health" and r._field == "failing_streak")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Failing Streak"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status" and r._field == "uptime_ns" and r.container_status != "running")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "container_image", "container_status", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Uptime"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["container_name"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status" and r._field == "exitcode" and r.container_status != "running")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Exit Code"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status" and r._field == "restart_count" and r.container_status != "running")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Restart Count"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r._field == "usage_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "container_name", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_mem" and r._field == "usage_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "container_name", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_net" and r.network == "total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rx_bytes" or r._field == "tx_bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._field == "tx_bytes" then -1.0 * r._value else r._value }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "container_name", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_blkio" and r.device == "total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "io_service_bytes_recursive_read" or r._field == "io_service_bytes_recursive_write")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._field == "io_service_bytes_recursive_write" then -1.0 * r._value else r._value }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "container_name", "_field", "_value"])
